actual_half_metadata.negative: The held whole-reference record uses the original negative half's K.left/right, physicalLeft/right, cell, chart/inverse/height/potential. The exact index is k = if side then (K.cutPair component).2 else (K.cutPair component).1.

coordinate_scopes.current_domain_obligation: CurrentJets is about literal atom values at fixed physicalUnitPoint/canonicalUnitPoint on all unitStrip. An estimate only on the moving current physicalPieceOpen, or only on a compact sub-half/collar, does not by itself meet that predicate. For the four target atoms, complete CurrentJets directly supplies the needed fixed canonical-unit domain, so this implication introduces no additional physical-domain extension step.
coordinate_scopes.endpoint_scope: SectorCanonicalJetBounds is an open canonical-piece estimate. The rescaling step uses only interior points; it adds no arbitrary boundary trace or closed-endpoint hypothesis.

route.title: Keep the zero-direction loss before every spatial order
route.construction: Choose ell := hcur.2.1.choose and hdiff := hcur.2.1.choose_spec once. For each s choose b0>0 from href.2 s and b1>0 from hdiff s. These choices precede every state, piece, atom and point.
route.quantifiers: exists ell, forall s, exists b0,b1>0, forall state/piece/point and a+b<=s.

route.title: Extract explicit inverse-length E0 cost at zero order
route.construction: Choose bL>0 from href.2 0. Apply its bound to atom .canonicalLengthInverse at (1/2,0), orders 0,0. spaces_mixedDerivative_zero and the atom definition give |rho_m^(-1)| <= bL*E_m^bL for every m.
route.positivity: rho_m>0 removes the absolute value when needed.
route.important: The existing n07a_canonicalLengthInverse_subpower wraps this projection into an M-subpower predicate. Reuse the projection argument or add a tiny explicit-bound lemma, not that weaker output.

route.title: Add the reference and true current-minus-reference jets
route.construction: At any unitStrip point p and sector parameter w, n07a_geometryAtom_jet_decomposition identifies the actual current jet with differenceJets plus the reference jet. Apply the two actual bounds and abs_add_le.
route.regularity: The decomposition uses the actual open-unit ContDiffOn clauses of href and hcur. It is not a formal linearity rule for arbitrary nondifferentiable total derivatives.

route.title: Undo only the canonical affine radial scale
route.construction: Let L=1+bL. Since E_m>=1 and a<=s, rho_m^(-a) <= L^s*E_m^(bL*s). Use the exact inverse affine identity on the actual potential or gated divided scalar field at y in canonicalOpen.
route.bound: Each target scalar has |D_canonical^(a,b) f(y)| <= L^s * [b0*E_m^(b0+bL*s) + b1*H_m^(3/4)*E_m^(b1+bL*s)*G_s(w)].
route.no_loss_change: The affine map is fixed for each piece and independent of state. Its radial factor changes only a numeric material exponent. It neither increases spatial order nor changes ell.

route.title: Absorb the material height gain at the exact stored sample
route.construction: Invoke material_sample_height_coefficient_power_bounded hD hT K.cell (b1+bL*s) with beta=3/4. This chooses Ds>0 before m and yields H_m^(3/4)*E_m^(b1+bL*s) <= Ds.
route.sample_scope: The theorem works for every fixed cell map K.cell. No equality with C.cell, no whole-component common-cell assertion and no replacement sample is needed.
route.result: With Rs=b0+bL*s>0 and Cs=L^s*(b0+b1*Ds)>0, the bound is <= Cs*E_m^Rs*(1+G_s(w)); E_m^Rs>=1 absorbs the pure current term.

route.title: Use the four literal target atoms and pack one constant
route.construction: For potential, the unit atom is exactly K.potential(current,m) o canonicalUnitPoint. On K.positive m=true the divided atoms are the three actual divided fields composed with the same map; on false pieces their unit atoms and the target's gated sum vanish. One Bool split on the piece suffices.
route.packing: coefficientEnvelope_pack (4*Cs) Rs returns Bs>0 with 4*Cs*t^Rs <= Bs*t^Bs for t>=1. Apply at t=E_m and multiply by the nonnegative grading factor.
route.zero_order: s=0 is included: the affine factor is 1, the selected derivative orders are 0, and the reference/current zero-order atom bounds are already present.

route.title: Return from sector parameters to the original state without changing the grading
route.construction: For z in stateNeighborhood with stateSector S z.1, use n07aSectorParameterOfState hrefState z hs. Its membership lemma gives the exact same sectorNeighborhood base epsilon epsilon and its lift lemma gives literal z.
route.exact_grading: parameterGrading S n (n07aSectorParameterOfState hrefState z hs) = stateGrading S n (z.1-C.referenceState) + |z.2|.
route.implementation: The exact grading identity is pairGrading_apply plus sectorGrading's subtype composition and realGrading=normSeminorm. The inspected N08 center/grading lemmas provide an existing alternative with the same identity.
route.result: 1+G_s = 1+stateGrading S (s+ell)(z.1-C.referenceState)+|z.2| up to add_assoc; no factor, derivative shift or neighborhood reduction is introduced.

route.title: Synchronize the cumulative loss if N01--N03 already uses another loss
route.construction: For oldLoss from the same Through03 witness, set finalLoss=max oldLoss ell, once before s. The just-derived Sector bound increases its state grading by stateGrading_monotone; all numerical constants remain valid.
route.through03: nonlinearPropertiesThrough03_restrict hT hN with base'=base, epsilon'=epsilon and loss'=finalLoss retains exactly D/T/S/C/R/L. Epsilon positivity is already in N01.
route.result: The final N04Properties and preceding Through03 can use one common base, finalLoss and epsilon without rebuilding K, changing a cell, or choosing a new family.

route.title: Apply the existing exact completion only after the sector bound is proved
route.construction: Given same-K hA:N04PartA and hB:N04PartB, n04Properties_normalized_of_sector_jetBounds hT hD hA hB hsector proves N04Properties for normalizedCanonicalData S K at the same base/loss/epsilon.
route.preserved: The charts, inverse charts, height, coefficients, endpoints, cell, physical domains and source pairing are retained. The normalization only sets unused off-sector potential and off-sector/nonpositive divided fields to zero.
route.not_full_statement: This is N04Properties, not the entire NonlinearPropertiesThrough04 or N04Statement. Other retained primitive and standalone calculus targets are still required.

material_normalization.safe_order: Use explicitly enlarged final material data before the final reference-family choice, or prove exact transfer on the fixed old K. The route starts only after href and hcur are statements over that same final T.
material_normalization.why_floor_must_be_explicit: IsMaterialData gives E0>0, not E0>=1. For 0<t<1, raising the exponent decreases t^A; coefficientEnvelope_pack is explicitly conditional on t>=1. A scaled C0*E0 floor is not permission to silently drop C0 from a single-B E0-only target.
material_normalization.full_atom_caveat: Changing T.E0 also changes the literal ratioE0 and ratioE0Inverse atom functions. The existing Through03 enlargement theorem is not a blanket ReferenceJets/CurrentJets transport theorem. Complete jets must be established for the final same-T atoms; the four potential/divided atom functions themselves do not depend on T.E0.
material_normalization.same_sample: enlargedMaterialData preserves sample, H, M, ell, radius and all geometry fields. No sample is reselected.

quantifier_audit.single_loss: ell is independent of s,m,z,theta and of the derivative split. finalLoss=max oldLoss ell is also chosen before s.
quantifier_audit.base: The implication keeps the already fixed base and epsilon. Per-order low-box controls requiring a new base(s) or smaller epsilon(s) do not meet CurrentJets clause 2 and cannot be used here.
quantifier_audit.directional_loss: The separate forall k exists loss(k) third clause of CurrentJets is not used in this implication. Its genuine SmoothDirections tower is still required by the full PrimitiveGeometryProperties target; ordinary spatial jets or a qualitative circle tower cannot replace it.
quantifier_audit.spatial_vs_parameter: The natural a,b in the rescaling are spatial derivative orders. They are not state-directional k and do not cause a new parameterLoss.

do_not_use_as_substitutes.reason: Its result is an M-subpower envelope, not an explicit E0 polynomial. Reuse its exact decomposition/raw projections, not the weakened final envelope.
This also exposes sampled subpower. It is useful downstream for weighted spaces but does not prove the frozen single-B E0 estimate by itself.
It allows an N-dependent low order and a polynomial power of state size on current physical domains. That is different from one fixed loss and linear state size on the fixed unit atoms.
It is a reference-state identity. It supplies no current-state bound or state-directional tower.
